fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $60,000, paid in lump sum upon signing. During 2025, waivers and discounts resulted in fees ranging from $0 to $60,000. Discounts/programs include: Franchise Option Program (full refund of fee in exchange for 4% royalty rate increase for 10-year term); Military/First Responder Program (20% reduction for first franchise); Multi-Unit Program (25% reduction on second and additional franchises when purchasing 3 or more); Hard to Serve/Underserved Markets Program (up to 10% discount). All waivers/reductions granted at franchisor's sole discretion.
raw_excerpt: You must pay to us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") in a lump sum payment of $60,000 upon signing the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is due in full at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement. ... During 2025 our franchise offering included waivers and discounts such that our Initial Franchise Fee ranged from $0 to $60,000.
